title: Day 2 / 500 — ATS-Y1-002 Add Java Runtime Diagnostics
subtitle: Continue from the exact Day 1 repository state.

steps.title: Day 2.1 Verify Day 1 remote SHA and read existing source
steps.why: Start from the verified Day 1 handoff instead of recreating the application.

steps.title: Day 2.2 Add non-instantiable RuntimeEnvironmentReport utility
steps.why: Create a focused utility class for runtime diagnostics without allowing unnecessary object instances.

steps.title: Day 2.3 Read Java runtime and JVM identity from system properties
steps.why: Expose the active Java version, runtime, JVM, vendor, and OS using standard system properties.

steps.title: Day 2.4 Invoke runtime diagnostics from the existing main method
steps.why: Extend the existing Day 1 main method rather than creating a second application entry point.

steps.title: Day 2.5 Compile both classes with Java 8 target compatibility
steps.why: Compile the existing application and the new diagnostic utility together using the Java 8 target.

steps.title: Day 2.6 Run the application and inspect the active runtime
steps.why: Use the runtime report to distinguish the project's Java 8 target from the workstation JVM executing the class.

steps.title: Day 2.7 Inspect generated bytecode with javap
